subject: GCP Partner Nexus: Quarterly joint pipeline mapping
messages:
From: Amy Lee <amy@verticloud.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@verticloud.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP Partner Nexus: Quarterly joint pipeline mapping

Hi Jasmine / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro — excited to kick off a more structured quarterly sync between VertiCloud and Redwood on GCP co-sell opportunities. Attached is a first-pass pipeline spreadsheet (pipeline-q4-verticloud.xlsx) that lists the accounts we think are co-sell-ready and their current stage. High level asks from our side: 

- Can Redwood confirm which of these will map to GCP co-sell eligibility (SKUs/partner type)?
- Who on your side will own technical validation for each pilot account?
- Proposal: 60-minute joint review week of Nov 1 to align owners and next steps.

Quick notes on the sheet: accounts 3, 7, and 11 are highest priority (budget + pilot committed). Procurement copied here (procurement@verticloud.com) for any contract readiness questions.

Attachments: pipeline-q4-verticloud.xlsx, VertiCloud-Intro-OnePager.pdf

If you want, we can split the review into two 45-minute blocks: (1) go/no-go and owner alignment, (2) technical validation plan. Please suggest availability.

Best,
Amy Lee
Head of Partner GTM, VertiCloud
amy@verticloud.com

Amy — thanks for the sheet and the suggested cadence.

On Thu, Oct 22, 2026 at 3:12 PM Amy Lee <amy@verticloud.com> wrote:
> Hi Jasmine / Vanessa,
> 
> Thanks again for the intro — excited to kick off a more structured quarterly sync...

We reviewed the spreadsheet quickly and think a combined 60-minute kickoff week of Nov 1 works for our team. Can you do Tue Nov 2 or Wed Nov 3 (PST)? I’ve looped in Karthik to own marketplace listing questions and Vanessa to run co-sell ops and pipeline orchestration.

Before the meeting it would help if you: 1) flag the three highest-priority accounts you want to go through co-sell this quarter, and 2) share any existing GCP Marketplace SKU or listing docs you have (we'll map Redwood model/policy requirements to those SKUs). We have an internal checklist we’ll bring (tech validation window, billing model, PoC success criteria).

I attached a short agenda stub (GCP-Partner-Nexus-Agenda.pdf) — feel free to edit.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

-Jasmine

- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c (pipeline + technical attachments)
- DocuSign: 0a9b-verticloud-nda (NDA in progress for account 7)

See you Nov 2 — thanks for coordinating.

—Amy
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Amy Lee <amy@verticloud.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP Partner Nexus: Quarterly joint pipeline mapping — pre-read + action items

Thanks everyone — quick pre-read and owners before our Nov 2 kickoff (10:00 AM PST). I pulled the two docs and sketched a suggested run of show and owners. Quoting Amy's note above for context.

Run of show (60m):
- 10m: Introductions & objectives (Jasmine)
- 15m: Pipeline review — VertiCloud prioritization and status (Amy / Alex)
- 20m: Redwood ops mapping — co-sell eligibility & marketplace listing gaps (Karthik)
- 10m: Next steps & deadlines (Vanessa)

Action items (owners):
- Amy / Alex: Send technical test accounts for accounts 3 & 7 by 2026-10-28 (external)
- Karthik: Draft initial SKU mapping & listing gap doc by 2026-11-05 (internal) — will use gcp-cosell-sku-list.pdf as baseline
- Vivek: Reserve dedicated slot for tech validation week of Nov 8–12; coordinate infra for PoC (internal)
- Jasmine: Confirm commercial owner and attach PoC success criteria to each flagged account by 2026-10-29 (internal)
- Vanessa: Schedule follow-up check on Nov 12 to confirm tech validation outcomes (internal)

Notes: please add any blockers in the sheet and flag any accounts that need legal escalation. I also uploaded a mirrored copy of the spreadsheet to our shared Drive folder (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c).

Onward — see you Tuesday.

-Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
